mainEntity.name: What is the typical structure of a HIIT class at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical HIIT class at Cave Training begins with a dynamic warm-up to prepare your body for intense activity, including mobility drills and light cardio. This is followed by the main workout, which consists of several rounds of high-intensity exercises interspersed with brief recovery periods. Exercises may include a mix of bodyweight movements, free weights, or functional equipment, tailored to our functional fitness approach. The class concludes with a cool-down and stretching to aid recovery. This structured process ensures a safe and effective session, optimizing your performance and minimizing post-workout soreness.
acceptedAnswer.description: A HIIT class at Cave Training includes a dynamic warm-up, high-intensity exercise intervals with recovery, and a cool-down. This structured process optimizes performance and recovery.
